claims: SpaceX successfully launched a Falcon 9 Block 5 rocket carrying 29 Starlink satellites.
The launch occurred on Sunday, March 22, 2026.
The launch occurred from Launch Complex 40, Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.
The Starlink 10-62 mission lifted off at 10:47 a.m. EDT (1447 UTC).
The first-stage booster successfully landed on a droneship in the Atlantic Ocean.
NASA has completed the rollout of the Artemis II rocket.
The Artemis II rocket has a targeted launch in April 2026.
